18646-gypsy-s-cousin-joy.title: Gypsy'S Cousin Joy
18646-gypsy-s-cousin-joy.creator: Elizabeth Stuart Phelps
18646-gypsy-s-cousin-joy.description: A book by Elizabeth Stuart Phelps. How in the world did Gypsy "grow up?" For that was before toboggans and telephones, before bicycles and electric cars, before bangs and puffed sleeves, before girls studied Greek, and golf-capes came in. For the Annex, and Smith, and Wellesley were not. Did she edit a Quarterly Review, or sing a baby to sleep? Did she write poetry, or make pies?

54654-the-sunken-isthmus-or-frank-reade-.title: The Sunken Isthmus Or Frank Reade Jr In The Yucatan Channel
54654-the-sunken-isthmus-or-frank-reade-.creator: Unknown
54654-the-sunken-isthmus-or-frank-reade-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Opposite it and upon the eastern extremity of mystic Yucatan is Cape Catoche. Between these two points of land lies that body of water which connects the Gulf of Mexico with the Caribbean Sea and known as the Yucatan Channel.

arxiv-1512-08961.title: A Generalization of Brown’s Construction for the Degree/Diameter Problem
arxiv-1512-08961.creator: Yawara ISHIDA
arxiv-1512-08961.description: Abstract The degree/diameter problem is the problem of finding the largest possible number of vertices n Δ , D n_{\Delta,D} in a graph of given degree Δ \Delta and diameter D D . We consider the problem for the case of diameter D = 2 D=2 .

arxiv-1605-08290.title: A note on alternating minimization algorithms: Bregman frame
arxiv-1605-08290.creator: Tao Sun, Lizhi Cheng
arxiv-1605-08290.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a Bregman frame for several classical alternating minimization algorithms. In the frame, these algorithms have uniform mathematical formulation. We also present convergence analysis for the frame algorithm. Under the Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz property, stronger convergence is obtained.

arxiv-2102-01722.title: A Historical and Statistical Study of the Software Vulnerability Landscape
arxiv-2102-01722.creator: Assane Gueye, Peter Mell
arxiv-2102-01722.description: Abstract Understanding the landscape of software vulnerabilities is key for developing effective security solutions. Fortunately, the evaluation of vulnerability databases that use a framework for communicating vulnerability attributes and their severity scores, such as the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), can help shed light on the nature of publicly published vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2102-09353.title: Spatial Correlation Robust Inference Thanks: Müller acknowledges financial support from the National Science Foundation grant SES-191336.
arxiv-2102-09353.creator: Ulrich K. Müller, Mark W. Watson
arxiv-2102-09353.description: Abstract We propose a method for constructing confidence intervals that account for many forms of spatial correlation. The interval has the familiar ‘estimator plus and minus a standard error times a critical value’ form, but we propose new methods for constructing the standard error and the critical value.

arxiv-2311-12702.title: “There Has To Be a Lot That We’re Missing”: Moderating AI-Generated Content on Reddit CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in collaborative and social computing
arxiv-2311-12702.creator: Travis Lloyd, Joseph Reagle, Mor Naaman
arxiv-2311-12702.description: Abstract . Generative AI has begun to alter how we work, learn, communicate, and participate in online communities. How might our online communities be changed by generative AI? To start addressing this question, we focused on online community moderators’ experiences with AI-generated content (AIGC).

arxiv-2402-19353.title: Robust nodal behavior in the thermal conductivity of superconducting UTe 2
arxiv-2402-19353.creator: Ian M. Hayes, Tristin E. Metz, Corey E. Frank, Shanta R. Saha, Nicholas P. Butch, Vivek Mishra, P.J. Hirschfeld, Johnpierre Paglione
arxiv-2402-19353.description: Abstract The superconducting state of the heavy-fermion metal UTe 2 has attracted considerable interest because of evidence for spin-triplet Cooper pairing and non-trivial topology. Progress on these questions requires identifying the presence or absence of nodes in the superconducting gap function and their dimension.

arxiv-2404-17902.title: Semiclassical perspective on Landau levels and Hall conductivity in an anisotropic Cubic Dirac Semi-Metal and the peculiar case of star-shaped classical orbits
arxiv-2404-17902.creator: Ahmed Jellal, Hocine Bahlouli, Michael Vogl
arxiv-2404-17902.description: Abstract We study an anisotropic cubic Dirac semi-metal subjected to a constant magnetic field. In the case of an isotropic dispersion in the x x - y y plane, with parameters v x = v y v_{x}=v_{y} , it is possible to find exact Landau levels, indexed by the quantum number n n , using the typical ladder operator approach.

arxiv-2506-05645.title: Magnetic excitations in the 1/3 plateau state in InCu 3 (OH) 6 Cl 3
arxiv-2506-05645.creator: Moyu Kato 1, Hiroyuki K. Yoshida 1, R. Kumar 1, Yoshihiko Ihara 1
arxiv-2506-05645.description: Abstract Magnetic dynamics in InCu 3 (OH) 6 Cl 3 was investigated from the NMR relaxation rate measurement. In InCu 3 (OH) 6 Cl 3 , the magnetization isotherm shows a plateau at the 1/3 of full-saturation magnetization, characterizing the 1/3 plateau state.

arxiv-2507-05745.title: N-body simulations of galaxy bars generated by satellite collisions: effects of the impact geometry GADGET-4 ( Springel 2005 ; Springel et al. 2021 )
arxiv-2507-05745.creator: Yufan Fane Zhou, Zhiyuan Li, Hui Li
arxiv-2507-05745.description: Abstract Bars, a common and important structure in disk galaxies, can be induced by galaxy interactions. Although there have been some studies on bar formation in flybys or collisions, the vast parameter space still leaves many scenarios that require further investigation.

arxiv-2509-12022.title: Learning non-Markovian Dynamical Systems with Signature-based Encoders
arxiv-2509-12022.creator: Eliott Pradeleix, Rémy Hosseinkhan-Boucher, Alena Shilova, Onofrio Semeraro, Lionel Mathelin
arxiv-2509-12022.description: Abstract Neural ordinary differential equations offer an effective framework for modeling dynamical systems by learning a continuous-time vector field. However, they rely on the Markovian assumption—that future states depend only on the current state—which is often untrue in real-world scenarios where the dynamics may depend on the history of past states.

arxiv-2605-08286.creator: Hyunmog Kim

europmc-pmc8282847.description: Cryo-EM maps are valuable sources of information for protein structure modeling. pmc-10542811.title: Memory-efficient low-compute segmentation algorithms for bladder-monitoring smart ultrasound devices
pmc-10542811.creator: Zhiye Song, Mercy Asiedu, Shuhang Wang, Qian Li, Arinc Ozturk, Vipasha Mittal, Scott Schoen, Srinath Ramaswamy, Theodore T. Pierce, Anthony E. Samir, Yonina C. Eldar, Anantha Chandrakasan, Viksit Kumar
pmc-10542811.description: Post-operative urinary retention is a medical condition where patients cannot urinate despite having a full bladder. Ultrasound imaging of the bladder is used to estimate urine volume for early diagnosis and management of urine retention. Moreover, the use of bladder ultrasound can reduce the need for an indwelling urinary catheter and the risk of catheter-associated urinary tract infection.

pmc-10644830.title: Making the Genotypic Variation Visible: Hyperspectral Phenotyping in Scots Pine Seedlings
pmc-10644830.creator: Jan Stejskal, Jaroslav Čepl, Eva Neuwirthová, Olusegun Olaitan Akinyemi, Jiří Chuchlík, Daniel Provazník, Markku Keinänen, Petya Campbell, Jana Albrechtová, Milan Lstibůrek, Zuzana Lhotáková
pmc-10644830.description: Hyperspectral reflectance contains valuable information about leaf functional traits, which can indicate a plant’s physiological status. Therefore, using hyperspectral reflectance for high-throughput phenotyping of foliar traits could be a powerful tool for tree breeders and nursery practitioners to distinguish and select seedlings with desired adaptation potential to local environments. We evaluated the use of 2 nondestructive methods (i.e.

pmc-11322199.title: Changes in epidermal thickness and their correlation with clinical characteristics in patients with vitiligo
pmc-11322199.creator: Luling Huang, Weiwei Sun, Zhubiao Ye, Yu Liu, Kaiqiao He, Shuli Li
pmc-11322199.description: Vitiligo is an autoimmune disorder characterized by epidermal melanocyte damage, with the typical clinical manifestation of white patches of skin. Keratinocytes, which work in concert with melanocytes to maintain the structural and functional integrity of the skin, are implicated in the progression of vitiligo.

pmc-11399081.title: Preclinical evaluation of tissue-selective gene therapies for congenital generalised lipodystrophy
pmc-11399081.creator: Mansi Tiwari, Ahlima Roumane, Nadine Sommer, Weiping Han, Mirela Delibegović, Justin J Rochford, George D Mcilroy
pmc-11399081.description: Lipodystrophy is a rare disorder which can be life-threatening. Here individuals fail to develop or maintain appropriate adipose tissue stores. This typically causes severe metabolic complications, including hepatic steatosis and lipoatrophic diabetes. There is no cure for lipodystrophy, and treatment options remain very limited.

pmc-11438113.title: Purchasing medicines and functional foods on the internet: a cross-sectional study investigating the knowledge, attitudes, and experience of Vietnamese people in 2023
pmc-11438113.creator: Dung Anh Doan, Nhung Hong Vu, Phuong Lan Nguyen, An Duc Nguyen, Dai Xuan Dinh
pmc-11438113.description: ObjectiveTo investigate Vietnamese people’s knowledge, attitudes, and experience in purchasing medicines and functional foods online.MethodsVia an online survey, the data of 1,070 participants were collected, including their general characteristics, Internet use, previous experience, knowledge, and attitudes towards purchasing medicines/functional foods online. Factors associated with their knowledge and attitudes were identified via multivariate linear regression models.ResultsDuring 2022–2023, about 97.

pmc-11673154.title: Aging Lung: Molecular Drivers and Impact on Respiratory Diseases—A Narrative Clinical Review
pmc-11673154.creator: Paweł Górski, Adam J Białas, Wojciech J Piotrowski, Rudolf Lucas
pmc-11673154.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The aging process significantly impacts lung physiology and is a major risk factor for chronic respiratory diseases, including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), asthma, and non-IPF interstitial lung fibrosis. This narrative clinical review explores the molecular and biochemical hallmarks of aging, such as oxidative stress, telomere attrition, genomic instability, epigenetic modifications, proteostasis loss, and impaired macroautophagy, and their roles in lung senescence.

pmc-11707473.title: Reporting quality of animal research in journals that published the ARRIVE 1.0 or ARRIVE 2.0 guidelines: a cross-sectional analysis of 943 studies
pmc-11707473.creator: Yao Lin, Fanghui Yang, Binghan Shang, John E Speich, Yu-Jui Yvonne Wan, Hiroki Hashida, Tobias Braun, Ali Sadoughi, Thomas Puehler, Tom F Lue, Kaiping Zhang
pmc-11707473.description: BackgroundThe adherence to the Animals in Research: Reporting In Vivo Experiments (ARRIVE) guidelines across the journals that initially published the guidelines and if adherence has improved since the guidelines update, remains unknown. We aimed to quantify the level of adherence and analyze factors that might influence reporting quality among these journals.

pmc-12436927.title: Mental health professional impact of dualistic approach on the biological model of depression
pmc-12436927.creator: Ž Kralj, S Melissa Pranić, T Mastelić, T Borovina Marasović, T Kozina, S Kozina
pmc-12436927.description: IntroductionIn psychopathology, a dualistic approach often refers to the conceptual separation of the mind and body as distinct entities, which can influence how mental disorders are classified and diagnosed. This separation may lead to biased judgments and contribute to the stigmatization of mental health conditions.

pmc-12532450.title: Translated versions of the English satisfaction with life scale (SWLS) among adult participants: a systematic review
pmc-12532450.creator: Razel Bacuetes Milo, Nicole Martinez, Theresa Asmus, Jennie Lee, Kathleen Soon, Jaden Milo, Patricia Calero
pmc-12532450.description: BackgroundLife satisfaction is the cognitive assessment of an individual’s current life circumstances. Since its introduction, the Satisfaction with Life Scale (SWLS) has been translated into more than 30 languages. However, there is a limited information on the comprehensive synthesis of the psychometric methods of the translated SWLS versions.

pmc-12567283.title: Formulation Strategies for Immunomodulatory Natural Products in 3D Tumor Spheroids and Organoids: Current Challenges and Emerging Solutions
pmc-12567283.creator: Chang-Eui Hong, Su-Yun Lyu
pmc-12567283.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Natural products exhibit significant immunomodulatory potential but face severe efficacy loss in three-dimensional (3D) tumor models. This review comprehensively examines the penetration–activity trade-off and proposes integrated strategies for developing effective natural product-based cancer immunotherapies. Methods: We analyzed formulation strategies across three natural product categories (hydrophobic, macromolecular, stability-sensitive), evaluating penetration enhancement versus activity preservation in spheroids, organoids, and advanced 3D platforms.

pmc-12639649.title: l-Glycine and l-leucine derived multifunctional ionic liquids for potential antibacterial applications: in-vitro and in-silico studies
pmc-12639649.creator: Amina Arshad, Hira Akram, Habib Ullah, Saadia Andleeb, Muhammad Shafiq, Zaheer Ul-Haq, Rawaiz Khan, Ali Bahadar, Azhar Mahmood, Mudassir Iqbal
pmc-12639649.description: Ionic liquids (ILs) have gained significant attention among material scientists for their versatile properties. Amino acid-based ionic liquids (AAILs) have the potential to be tailored for desired physicochemical properties due to their structural adaptability and unique attributes. Twenty-four distinct ILs were synthesized, containing multifunctional cations viz. 1-octyl pyridinium, 1-octyl-3-methylimidazolium, 1,3-dioctylimidazolium, Di-octyldi-butylammonium, Tetraoctylphosphonium, N, N, N', N'-Tetrakis-(2-hydroxyethyl)dioctyldiammonium, 1H-1,2,3-triazole, and 1-octyl-1,8-diazabicyclo(5.4.

pmc-12654767.title: Synergy and Attenuation of Work-Related Factors in Musculoskeletal Disorders: The Combined Risk Based on Data from the Korean Working Conditions Survey
pmc-12654767.creator: Eun-Soo Lee, Myong-Hwan Kim, Dongmug Kang, Youn-Hyang Lee, Yoon-Ji Kim, Se-Yeong Kim, Youngki Kim, Jimmy T Efird
pmc-12654767.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and objectives: Musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) account for more than 60% of compensated occupational diseases in Korea. Despite this burden, benchmarks of standardized ergonomic exposure and evidence on the combined effects of risk factors remain limited. This study aimed to construct a body part-specific ergonomic job exposure matrix (JEM) and evaluate the independent and interactive effects of ergonomic, demographic, and work-related factors. Materials and Methods: We analyzed the data of 210,500 workers from the 2nd–6th Korean Working Conditions Survey (2009–2020).

pmc-13166450.title: Fulfilling end-of-life dreams: A scoping review of bucket lists in palliative and hospice care
pmc-13166450.creator: Swasati Handique, Michael Bennett, Scott D Ryan
pmc-13166450.description: ObjectivesThe purpose of this study is to examine the existing literature on end-of-life dream experiences and bucket list fulfillments among terminally ill individuals receiving hospice and/or palliative care.MethodsA scoping review registered on Open Science Framework was conducted in accordance with the guidelines for Scoping reviews (PRISMA-ScR). An electronic search of literature was generated from EBSCO databases published until June 2024.

pmc-13331760.title: Determinants of vertical transmission of HIV infection in Kilifi County, Kenya: a case-control study
pmc-13331760.creator: Rukiya Mohammed Koriow, Julius Otieno Oyugi, Christine Muasya, Rodgers Onsomu Moindi
pmc-13331760.description: Introductionmother-to-child transmission of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a significant contributor to pediatric HIV infections in Kenya despite expanded prevention services. Persistent gaps along the prevention of mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) cascade continue to undermine elimination efforts.Methodswe conducted a retrospective, unmatched case-control study using routinely collected PMTCT data from selected health facilities in Kilifi County, Kenya.

pmc-13400105.creator: Maxime Dubosq-Lebaz, Peter A. Schneider, Nathan W. Watson, Marianne Brodmann, John H. Rundback, Eric A. Secemsky

pmc-13479130.title: Improved visible photocatalytic CO oxidation of CoTiO3 nanotubes by surface engineering and Au nanoparticle loading
pmc-13479130.creator: Zhanyu Chu, Tianwei Dou, Zhuo Li, Lei Sun, Liqiang Jing
pmc-13479130.description: The tubular structure photocatalyst, known for its excellent light absorption and mass diffusion properties, represents an attractive class of photocatalytic materials for the removal of toxic gaseous pollutants. However, the availability of adsorption activation sites and the separation of photogenerated charges remain insufficient, making improvements in these aspects meaningful.

pmc-13576815.title: Influence of Concave Versus Convex Emergence Profiles on Midfacial Mucosal Stability—A Systematic Review With Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13576815.creator: Miha Pirc, Priscilla Balzarini, Jonathan Esquivel, Anina N. Zuercher, Ronald E. Jung, Franz J. Strauss

pmc-13623931.title: Sex-associated circadian signaling signatures in the lateral hypothalamus
pmc-13623931.creator: Sara K. Pintwala, Patrick M. Fuller
pmc-13623931.description: IntroductionThe lateral hypothalamus (LH) is a central integrative hub coordinating arousal, feeding, metabolism, stress responsiveness, and sleep-wake state transitions. These functions are not static across the 24-hour cycle, but instead are dynamically gated according to circadian phase and internal physiological state.

pmc-13634041.title: When screening and diagnosis converge: participant interpretations of additional findings in the 100,000 genomes project
pmc-13634041.creator: Susie Weller, Anneke Lucassen
pmc-13634041.description: Genomic science is a central feature of the UK government’s current 10-year health plan for England, which places significant emphasis on prediction and prevention. Although NHS prevention strategies have long been aimed at catching diseases earlier and at a more treatable stage, genomics until now has focussed largely on diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-13678922.title: 3Rs principles for biomedical research in Africa: Evidence, challenges, early career researchers’ perspectives, and pathways for One Health research governance
pmc-13678922.creator: Olawale F Olaniyan, Modou Dumbuya
pmc-13678922.description: BackgroundThe 3Rs principles (Replacement, Reduction, and Refinement) are globally recognized as a cornerstone of ethical animal research and an essential component of responsible biomedical research systems. Nonetheless, evidence on the awareness, reporting, and implementation in African research settings remain limited.
